scope: Full merged R4 negative-native-nibble CPU map versus separately produced and reloaded raw-positive-byte strongest merged original map and independently produced/reloaded current19 per-reader maps. Input0 actual embeddings; input3 and FFN0 embedding probes contract-only. Full two-pass/all40 K128 scales and folds, exact immutable source/norm binding, every complete B row, all typed CPU snapshot views/tensor splits and reassembly. Not native FW8/MMA numerical acceptance.
raw_custody: Each independent full raw case has a lossless tar.zst and explicit member SHA256/size manifest. Every original raw byte was decompressed and compared before removing only the duplicate unpacked representation. Verification decompresses all members, checks logical full hashes/sizes and complete output/source/view contracts, including pilots.

CPU_contract.raw: Literal positive-sign byte tables independently built from original producer coordinates; each symbol sums eight explicitly decoded integer-grid values; full original row-major Q1 raw weights separately reloaded from GGUF.
CPU_contract.native: Literal negative-sign nibble tables consuming independently prepared merged native lane/group/K128/u16 weights and scale lanes. Candidate and independently produced per-reader controls each compare every exact raw/native K128 dot and fold word.
CPU_contract.strongest_merged: Independent immutable source copy and full producer invocation; independently loaded/concatenated raw weights, original prepared layout audited separately. A raw-only output accumulator is computed from positive byte tables, with independently computed candidate-native dot/scale/fold compared exactly at each of the40 ascending blocks; output never copied from candidate.
CPU_contract.fold: E2M1 times finite E4M3 in 2^-10 units; int32 to F32 then ldexp(-10), all40 ascending explicit fma with original half scale; global scale and primary/innovation add; ffp-contract=off.
CPU_contract.trace: FNV fingerprint of every block dot/half-scale/fold word per full pass output, saved independently for each arm. Fingerprints supplement exact in-loop comparisons and do not replace them.
CPU_contract.layout: Immutable owning CPU snapshot captures both complete primary and final BxF passes; stride F, exact byte offset/bounding extent and each actual row span. Independently saved per-reader contiguous views, every tensor split including both AB48 halves, and complete no-hole reassembly. Native BxF allocation/view lifetime and D2D effects are separate parent evidence.

Lean.scope: unchanged integer-map identities, not new C++/views/native refinement

retained_failures.scope: Receipt metadata parity compared case-prefixed ordinary/UBSan member names before normalization; corrected verifier normalizes only the case-name prefix and still requires every raw member SHA256/size equality. Numerical bytes unchanged.

retained_pilots.reason: Pre-final raw-only control returned full output and per-output trace fingerprints; final source additionally compares independently computed raw/native exact dot, scale and fold word at every K128 block. Pilot full raw evidence retained, not overwritten.
